title: Hotspot
hint.absent: No Wi-Fi device that can run a hotspot was found.
hint.noDnsmasq: The hotspot needs dnsmasq. Install it with: omarchy pkg add dnsmasq
hint.firewall: The firewall will block devices on the hotspot. Allow them once with: sudo %1/setup-firewall
hint.noUplink: There's no internet connection to share. Connect cellular or Ethernet.
hint.willDisconnect: Turning the hotspot on disconnects Wi-Fi from %1.
